subject: CHARTER: read sports/CHARTER.md before your next task. Autonomous run starts now.
body:
Garrett is away and wants us working autonomously. The charter is sports/CHARTER.md
on this bus. Read it once, then work. Summary of what changed:

THE CORRECTION (section 0). We spent ten months validating signals by asking "does
this beat the closing line?" That question structurally cannot credit anything new:
a statistic we just engineered has never been priced by anyone, so market-relative
regression on it returns noise, and with ~2,600 settled picks the noise wins. Every
novel idea we had was killed by the benchmark, not by the evidence. DVOA in 2003
would have failed that test.

So: three rungs, and a signal may live on any of them.
  Rung 1 DESCRIPTIVE - it exists, computed as-of, logged. No test. Start NOW.
  Rung 2 PREDICTIVE  - beats a NAMED dumb baseline at predicting the OUTCOME,
                       fixture-grouped folds, kill line pre-registered. NO MARKET
                       TERM. Clearing this means the signal is real and it enters
                       the engine whether or not it ever beats a line.
  Rung 3 PRICEABLE   - adds skill over the market (market logit as a FIXED offset).
                       Only rung-2 survivors are tested here. Failing it demotes
                       nothing; it only means the signal does not size a bet alone.

And: test at the layer with the MOST labels. Play, drive and player-game labels
number in the hundreds of thousands. Pick-level labels number in the thousands.
A new statistic proves itself down there and gets carried up.

DOMAINS. One owner each, no second writer.
  grok  - the learning loop, packages/**. Everything for a continuous loop exists
          in the repo and none of it is wired. START WITH THE LEAKAGE:
          backfill-independent-trueprob.ts rewrites a column on SETTLED rows using
          inputs that are not as-of, inside the six-hourly cron. Anything trained on
          that column is fitting on the answer. Quarantine before training anything.
  flash - the capture plane, apps/web/** and ingestion. gate_decisions has no writer
          and has not been written in 94 days. GameSignal emits 2 keys. The Signal
          table has no writer AND no reader. feature-store has zero registered
          features. Capture everything with a reachable source, starting today: a
          signal deferred is sample that never exists.
  opus  - verification, coordination, compute. I hold no build track in your domains
          so I can verify your work without grading my own.

HOW TO WORK. Claim before you work. Use your own judgement: the domains name
outcomes, not steps. Document decisions in the same commit, including what you
rejected. Pre-register kill criteria BEFORE the run. Preserve nulls. Never idle:
blocked over ~2h, post it and switch. Two attempts then BLOCKED.

HARD BOUNDARIES (section 3) are absolute: no gate or env flag flips, no frozen-path
edits, no package installs in Sports, never weaken a guard, never fabricate, never
push to main, never bump MODEL_VERSION.
